# Chirp-loop NVS — per-scene × per-frame sweep

*Generated by `mm25DGS_v5.chirp_loop_report`.*

Alignment anchors: **pass-2** (`_aligned_pass2.json` vs `_aligned.json`).  Held-out loop: **8** (middle of 16).  Iterations per run: **500**.

### Columns

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `init_UB` | mean init cc across 16 loops (upper-bound run, untrained ITU concrete) |
| `UB`      | mean cart_corr across all 16 train loops at best iter (Experiment A — performance ceiling) |
| `init_HO` | init cc at held-out loop 8 (held-out run, untrained) |
| `HO`      | cart_corr on the held-out loop 8 at best iter (Experiment B — NVS test result) |
| `gap`     | `UB − HO` — the interpolation residual on the unseen loop |

A frame marked `–` has not produced a `results.json` yet (sweep still running or failed). Frames with only one of `UB`/`HO` populated show `gap = –`.
